title: Religion in space
source: Wikipedia - List of topics in space
executive_summary: Astronauts and other spaceflight participants have observed their religions while in space; sometimes publicly, sometimes privately. Religious adherence in outer space may pose unique challenges and opportunities for practitioners. Space travellers have reported changes in the way they view their faith related to the overview effect, some said that their faith grew stronger. Conversely, some secularist groups have criticized the use of government spacecraft for religious activities by astronauts.
